description: This file is a shell script that contains a series of tests for Git's handling of CRLF line endings, autocrlf configurations, and gitattributes. It includes functions to manipulate files' line endings, setup Git configurations, and verify behaviors through various test cases.

methods.name: has_cr
methods.description: Checks if a given file contains CRLF line endings.

methods.name: munge_cr
methods.description: Adds or removes CR characters in a file in-place depending on the argument.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case that expects success, wrapping various Git commands and assertions.

methods.name: cr_to_Q_no_NL
methods.description: Converts CR characters to 'Q' and removes newlines, used for verifying line ending conversions.
